def lcs(a, b):
    m, n = len(a), len(b)
    dp = [[0] * (n+1) for _ in range(m+1)]

    for i in range(1, m+1):
        for j in range(1, n+1):
            if a[i-1] == b[j-1]:
                dp[i][j] = dp[i-1][j-1] + 1
            else:
                dp[i][j] = max(dp[i-1][j], dp[i][j-1])

def knpsu_mod(m, k):
    @lru_cache(None)

def compute_radix_sum_ways(n, x):
